ParticipantA: Oh, I've heard that's a great book. I've been meaning to read it for a while now.

ParticipantA: Yeah, I totally agree. I think the literary world is always evolving and changing.
ParticipantB: Exactly. And there are so many new voices and perspectives to discover.
ParticipantA: Yeah, it's definitely an exciting time for literature.
ParticipantB: Definitely. Well, it was great talking to you.
